campaign.authorization: 2026-10-25 owner approves handoff, explicitly requests experiments/iteration using subagents and live runs; subsequent instruction requires checkpoint commit first (completed at b4a8084).
campaign.status: closed after declared experiments; no further calls invoked
campaign.scope: Saved admitted/conditional/incomplete sources; Luna-only isolated input/effort/topology comparison. No providers, FX, request mutation, runtime defaults or frontend changes.
campaign.execution: Start matched original/candidate medium admitted and conditional sentinels; independently review before continued low/topology. Interleave arms and reverse order on repeat; log actual order and cache conditions. Candidate changes are versioned and consume this same envelope. Stop a clearly unhelpful variant with explicit evidence; preserve failed calls. No automatic extension.
campaign.recovery: Use shared run_attempts: one initial final-document generation plus at most one correction for recoverable failed checks; better recoverable draft, correction wins ties; preserve annotated findings. Worker failure is explicit topology failure, no silent fallback or worker repair allowance.
campaign.quality: Independent source/composition review before timing-based recommendation. Material: wrong factual/date/price comparison, misleading eligible landscape, reference identity mismatch, invented completeness/booking protection or material missing uncertainty. Minor wording is separately reported. Mechanical checks do not prove narrative truth.
campaign.timing: Actual Results-only wall time includes source parsing, preparation/workspace, exact counting, worker critical path, composition, checking/resolution and actual correction; first text is not first usable display. Per-call timeout is not a whole-workflow deadline.
campaign.cost_basis: Estimate using recorded 2026-10-25 Luna rates: ordinary input0.10, cached0.01, cache-write0.125, output0.50 USD per million. Count billing/native Codex excluded; estimate not invoice.
campaign.claim_limits: Small development comparison; no SLA threshold supplied, statistical reliability/holdout, M2 owner presentation acceptance, frontend delivery, M3 qualification or runtime multi-agent adoption. Diagnostic artifacts are noncanonical; source evidence preserved. Owner decides what to keep/cut.

closeout.cost_limit: Recorded Oct25 rates,39 usage receipts; timed-out generation cost unknown. Excludes count billing and native Codex. Not an invoice.
closeout.stopping: Stop V1 low after material failures on all3cases; stop V2 parallel after its sentinel still fails schedule interpretation; finish V2 single low and medium cohorts without further prompt additions. V1 original/revised medium have2cohorts each; V2 single arms1cohort each; topology comparisons stopped early. Unused ceiling is not an ongoing campaign or a future session budget.
closeout.decision: Report candidates and uncertainty for owner keep/cut decision; no runtime defaults or topology adopted.

iteration_disposition_2026_10_26.observations: V1 revised-medium full cohort source-reviewed with minor weaknesses; original medium admitted/conditional have material omitted alternatives. V1 revised-low has material defects in all three cases. V1 parallel-low admitted has source errors and conditional/incomplete fail worker alias validation. All failures retained, including one earlier unknown-duration transport timeout.
iteration_disposition_2026_10_26.v1_repeats: Retain planned second original/revised medium cohort with reversed pair order. Stop repeating failed V1 low/topology protocols; new V2 comparisons are labeled independently, not pooled as V1 repeats.
iteration_disposition_2026_10_26.v2_hypothesis: More exact per-reference identity and traveler/seat evidence locality plus a targeted comparison brief, despite larger input, may let low effort compose correctly. Clarify exact worker aliases and permit existing whole-pool P1 only for true whole-pool findings; never normalize ranges or retry workers.
iteration_disposition_2026_10_26.next_schedule: Within the same unchanged 60/60 envelope: one matched three-case V2 single-low/parallel-low cohort, then repeat the more promising configuration on all three cases. Additional topology repeats only if remaining bound and evidence justify. Do not launch a run without headroom for its full bounded path (single<=2, parallel<=4 generations/counts). No automatic budget extension.
iteration_disposition_2026_10_26.attribution: V2 input/brief is a new bundle. Worker protocol changes are labeled V2; do not attribute differences from V1 solely to reasoning effort or parallelism. Compare V2 single/parallel using the same V2 input and final output contract.
iteration_disposition_2026_10_26.v2_sentinel_disposition: Single-low admitted facts improved but omitted material business/separate-ticket alternatives (source pass, composition failure after adjudication). Parallel-low admitted still reverses departure timing. Stop further V2 parallel calls: added analysis has not established quality benefit and adds a sequential phase. Finish single-low three-case cohort to characterize tradeoff.
iteration_disposition_2026_10_26.fixed_effort_v2_check: Declare V2 single-composer medium as the next bounded comparison on the same three cases; no new prompt mechanisms. Exact identity locality might reduce medium reasoning burden without lowering effort. It consumes the unchanged 60/60 envelope. Repeat the more promising single-composer configuration only if evidence and full-run headroom justify it; do not claim an unrun complete comparison.

failure_note.settings: 240 second SDK read timeout, zero retries
failure_note.observed: The shell process exited 1 with a ReadTimeout traceback. Count and generation were both reserved before invocation. No final response, raw usage or selected answer was saved.
failure_note.measurement_limit: Exact full wall time, first-event and first-text timings were lost because the harness caught APIError/ValueError but not httpx transport errors during iteration. Do not substitute 240s as measured Results wall time or infer usage/cost is zero.
failure_note.disposition: Retain as failed attempt. Fix transport-error capture with offline test; any replacement is a separately named manual sample under the same 60-generation/60-count ceiling, never an automatic retry. Original source snapshot and request remain unchanged.

cost_estimate_limit: Estimated from saved generation receipts only; count endpoint pricing and Codex work excluded; not an invoice.
quality_limit: Mechanical replay/check outcomes are distinct from independent source/composition review. No verdict is inferred when reviews.json is absent.
latency_limit: Results-only request path from saved projection; not intent/planning/provider workflow or a numerical SLA. First response text is not a rendered usable answer.
